title: Refund policy
body: Duplicate or accidental charges are refunded in full. Refunds go back to the original card within 5-7 business days. Every refund is approved by the billing team, who confirm by email.

title: How billing works
body: Plans are billed monthly on the day you signed up. Annual plans are billed once a year at a 15% discount. Plan changes are prorated.

title: Update your payment card
body: Owners can change the card in Settings, Billing, Payment method. The new card is used from the next invoice.

title: Download invoices
body: Every invoice is in Settings, Billing, Invoices. Click an invoice to download a PDF for your records or your accountant.

title: When a payment fails
body: We retry a failed payment three times over seven days and email the account owner each time. Update your card to avoid interruption; the account stays active during retries.

title: Set up SSO
body: Enterprise workspaces can enable SAML SSO in Settings, Security. You need your identity provider's metadata URL, entity ID and signing certificate.

title: Troubleshooting SSO sign-in
body: An invalid assertion error after changing identity provider usually means the certificate or entity ID in Settings, Security is out of date. Only workspace admins can change SSO settings; our security team can help verify the setup.

title: Reset your password
body: Use Forgot password on the sign-in page. After five failed attempts the account locks for 30 minutes for your protection.

title: Two-factor authentication
body: If you lose your 2FA device, use one of your backup codes. Without backup codes, our security team verifies your identity before resetting 2FA.

title: Export your data to CSV
body: Open Reports, choose a report, click Export and pick CSV or Excel. Exports up to 100,000 rows download immediately; larger exports are emailed as a ZIP.

title: Create an API key
body: Admins create API keys in Settings, Developers, API keys. Keys are shown once; store them securely and rotate them every 90 days.

title: API rate limits
body: The API allows 600 requests per minute on Team and 3,000 on Enterprise. Responses include rate limit headers; a 429 response means slow down and retry.

title: Service status
body: Live status for the API, Dashboard and Billing is at status.acme.example. During incidents we post updates every 30 minutes.

title: Cancel your subscription
body: Owners can request cancellation in Settings, Billing. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing period, and our team confirms every request by email.

title: Delete your account and data
body: Account deletion is permanent and removes all data after 30 days. Export anything you need first. Deletion requests are confirmed by our team.

title: Plans and pricing
body: Free: 1 user. Pro: $49 per month. Team: $12 per seat per month, minimum 5 seats. Enterprise: custom pricing with SSO, audit logs and a dedicated contact.

title: Change your plan
body: Upgrade or downgrade in Settings, Billing, Change plan. Upgrades apply immediately and are prorated; downgrades apply at the next billing date.

title: Invite teammates
body: Admins invite people from Settings, Members, Invite. On Team plans each member uses one seat; add seats any time.

title: Feature requests
body: We read every request. The product team reviews them weekly and tracks the most requested ideas on our public roadmap.

title: Slack integration
body: Connect Slack in Settings, Integrations to get report and alert notifications in any channel. Available on Team and Enterprise.
